extracted.name: Low fat blueberry scones
extracted.description: Never made scones before but I wanted a #lowfat version. It’s also #vegan. Recipe is from the 101 cooking for two blog, but I reduced it to make only 2 scones. US measurements.
instruction_lines: Mix wet ingredients into dry and stir to incorporate.
Flour a silicone baking mat, add dough, and separate into two portions. Add some flour on top of dough if the dough is too wet. Slightly flatten and dust with remaining sugar.
Bake about 16-18 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool, but also excellent served warm.
